user.title: Backup Manager Actions
user.description: Expose advanced Home Assistant Backup Manager operations to automations and scripts. No credentials or external service configuration are required.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Backup Manager Actions instance can be configured.

create.name: Create backup
create.description: Create one Home Assistant backup and store it on the selected Backup Manager agents.

agent_ids.name: Backup agents
agent_ids.description: Exact Backup Manager agent IDs that must receive the backup.

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional display name for the backup.

include_homeassistant.name: Include Home Assistant
include_homeassistant.description: Include Home Assistant configuration in the backup.

include_database.name: Include database
include_database.description: Include the Home Assistant database in the backup.

include_all_addons.name: Include all add-ons
include_all_addons.description: Include all installed add-ons. Do not use together with selected add-ons.

include_addons.name: Selected add-ons
include_addons.description: Add-on slugs to include when not including all add-ons.

include_folders.name: Folders
include_folders.description: Supervisor folders to include in the backup.

password.name: Password
password.description: Optional backup encryption password. The value is not stored by this integration.

delete.name: Delete backup
delete.description: Delete a backup by ID from all currently registered agents, or from an explicit set of agents.

agent_ids.name: Backup agents
agent_ids.description: Optional explicit agent IDs. If omitted, all currently registered agents are targeted.

list_backups.name: List backups
list_backups.description: Return all logical backups visible to Home Assistant Backup Manager, merged across agents.

get_backup.name: Get backup
get_backup.description: Return details for one logical backup.

list_agents.name: List backup agents
list_agents.description: Return all Backup Manager agents currently registered in Home Assistant.
